name: AUTOPILOT.OI Shop Agent
description_html:
Your TikTok Shop agent: find products, do the profit math, check the rules, get creators posting.

A Claude agent that finds product ideas for your niche and budget, scores them, works out what you keep per order after fees, shipping and creator commission, checks products and claims against TikTok Shop rules before you buy stock, writes your listing, plans your videos, drafts creator invites and runs a weekly review from your numbers.

What you get (15 page agent pack, PDF): a setup builder that installs the agent with you in about 30 minutes, 12 setup questions, full agent instructions with 10 commands, the worked example from our reel, a product scorecard, a profit calculator, creator scripts and a 30 day launch tracker.

How it works: it runs inside a Claude Project. It drafts, calculates and checks. It does not sign you up, buy stock, list products or message creators on its own, and it does not promise sales. Fees and rules change: it always uses the numbers from your Seller Center.

You need: a Claude account (the free plan works) and a TikTok account.

Education only. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic or TikTok.
